title: One consistent kit experience

changes.title: Premixed blends use the regular Stash kit design
changes.detail: Premixed and single-compound kits share the same card renderer, inventory heading, Open New Vial action, Prepare entry and Overview/Vials/History disclosure.

changes.title: One Open New Vial workflow
changes.detail: Both kit types use the same reconstitution form. Premixed composition and vial transactions remain linked to their source kit.

changes.title: One Log Dose workflow
changes.detail: Premixed blends use the standard logging form, with a compact composition breakdown and one blend dose event instead of duplicate ingredient administrations.

changes.title: Premixed inventory transaction safeguards
changes.detail: Blend inventory uses vial-ID ledger allocations for preparation and logging, with confirmation checks and historical record protections.

dataImpact: No automatic migration or history rewrite. New premixed doses remain under their blend name. Existing ingredient and vial records are preserved; ambiguous historical blend conversions remain intentionally unmodified.
limitations: Legacy kLOW kits created before blend metadata require explicit review; no automatic conversion is performed.
